commands.name: New-OfficeWord
commands.synopsis: Creates a Word document from the theme, optionally running a content block that saves and closes it.
commands.notes: Keeping a document open means leaving out the block: the Document set returns the live WordDocument, and -Path is optional there (Save-OfficeWord -Path later). With a block -Path is required. With -Content saves and closes when the block ends and returns the file only with -PassThru; if the block throws nothing is saved and the partial file is removed. -NoSave is removed. -TemplatePath clones an existing .docx as starting content; -Theme applies a visual theme (built-in name, OfficeTheme or a .dotx/.docx whose theme is read). Refuses to replace an existing file without -Force.

commands.name: Open-OfficeWord
commands.synopsis: Opens an existing Word document, optionally running a content block that saves and closes it.
commands.notes: Replaces Get-OfficeWord. With -Content the document is saved and closed at the end of the block (not with -ReadOnly); without it the live document is returned. Opening never restyles the document. Saving at block end fails if content would be lost unless -AllowLoss.

commands.name: Save-OfficeWord
commands.synopsis: Saves a live Word document to its own path or a new path without closing it.
commands.notes: -PassThru returns the saved file (FileInfo), not the document. A native save keeps today's strictness: it fails if content would be lost unless -AllowLoss.

commands.name: Close-OfficeWord
commands.synopsis: Closes one, the most recent, or all tracked Word documents, optionally saving them first.
commands.notes: The old -Current switch is dropped; the Current set is the default when neither -Document nor -All is given. -Path implies -Save. ShouldProcess applies only when it saves.

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordSection
commands.synopsis: Adds a section (page layout region) and runs its content block.

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordHeading
commands.synopsis: Adds a heading paragraph styled from the theme heading scale.
commands.notes: -Level 1-9 (default 1) maps to the built-in Heading1-Heading9 styles, so headings feed the table of contents and navigation pane. The Content set takes WordText runs. WordParagraph -Style Heading1 stays valid for custom flows.

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordParagraph
commands.synopsis: Adds a paragraph from text or from a content block of styled runs and inline elements.
commands.notes: -Run is removed: runs are WordText child commands. The untyped -Target (Document/Section) becomes -Document and -Section in their own sets. -Text together with -Content is no longer allowed; put the leading text in a WordText inside the block. Spacing, indentation and pagination of the current paragraph are set with Set-OfficeWordParagraph inside the block.

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordText
commands.synopsis: Adds a styled text run, optionally a hyperlink, to the current or given paragraph.
commands.notes: The single styled-run command: shared run vocabulary -Text -Bold -Italic -Strikethrough -Underline -Color -Font -Size -Link. Absorbs Add-OfficeWordHyperlink (-Link for URLs, -Anchor for bookmarks) and the WordBold/WordItalic aliases. Hyperlinks use the theme Hyperlink style unless -NoLinkStyle. -PassThru returns the paragraph, or the hyperlink in the Link/Anchor sets. Outside a paragraph it creates one, as today.

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordBreak
commands.synopsis: Adds a line, page or column break to the current paragraph.

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordTabStop
commands.synopsis: Adds a tab stop to the current paragraph.
commands.notes: -Position was an integer in twips; it is now a length (-Position 3in).

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordBookmark
commands.synopsis: Adds a bookmark to the current paragraph.
commands.notes: Declares [OutputType] (none today).

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordField
commands.synopsis: Adds a field (page, date, author, custom codes) to the current paragraph.

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordFootnote
commands.synopsis: Adds a footnote reference to the current paragraph.

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordEndnote
commands.synopsis: Adds an endnote reference to the current paragraph.

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordEquation
commands.synopsis: Adds an Office Math (OMML) equation.
commands.notes: -Paragraph and -Document become separate sets.

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordList
commands.synopsis: Starts a bulleted or numbered list and runs its items block.
commands.notes: The -Type alias of -Style is removed. Declares [OutputType].

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordListItem
commands.synopsis: Adds a list item from text or a content block of runs.
commands.notes: New Content set so an item can hold styled WordText runs, per the shared List/ListItem vocabulary.

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordTable
commands.synopsis: Writes objects as a themed table, with an optional block for conditions and cell content.
commands.notes: -InputObject enumerates arrays as rows, from the pipeline or as an argument. Without -Style the theme table style applies (header row, light banding, padding, right-aligned numbers) instead of TableGrid. -Transpose is removed (-View Transpose). The Data/SkipHeader parameter aliases are removed. Nested rows inside WordTableCell keep working.

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordTableCondition
commands.synopsis: Formats the rows of the enclosing table whose source object matches a filter.
commands.notes: -FilterScript becomes positional (WordTableCondition { $_.Status -eq 'At risk' } -BackgroundColor Danger). Theme roles (Danger, Warning, Success) resolve from the document theme.

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordTableCell
commands.synopsis: Enters a table cell by row and column and runs nested content inside it.
commands.notes: -Run is removed; styled text goes in the block as WordParagraph/WordText. -Row and -Column are 1-based, as Word numbers rows and columns.

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordTableRow
commands.synopsis: Appends a row of values to an existing Word table.
commands.notes: Object-model command (no DSL alias). -Values becomes -InputObject; arrays, dictionaries, objects and New-OfficeWordTableCell specs expand across cells.

commands.name: New-OfficeWordTableCell
commands.synopsis: Creates a cell definition (text, runs, spans, formatting) for explicit table rows.
commands.notes: Returns a data object, so it has no DSL alias. -Run is replaced by a Content block of WordText commands that the spec records. Run formatting uses the shared run names; -Underline takes the underline style (the separate -Underline switch and -UnderlineStyle merge).

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordChart
commands.synopsis: Adds a themed chart built from objects, one category property and one or more value properties.
commands.notes: -Category/-Value replace -CategoryProperty/-SeriesProperty. -Type uses the shared OfficeChartType (Word supports Pie, Bar, Column, Line, Area; others throw). -InputObject now binds from the pipeline, so Document/Paragraph lose pipeline binding. Without -SeriesColor the theme series palette applies instead of the hard-coded matplotlib colors. Width/Height take lengths (default 6.25in x 3.75in, the old 600x360 px).

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordImage
commands.synopsis: Adds an image file, SVG, or rendered visual (ChartForgeX artifact, OfficeVisualSource) to the current paragraph.
commands.notes: Absorbs Add-OfficeWordVisual (the InputObject set): both commands put a picture into a paragraph and return WordImage. -AlternativeText becomes -Description to match Set-OfficeWordImage. SVG limits are API-enforced resource limits and stay. Inner types of the SVG limits follow the current C# options.

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordShape
commands.synopsis: Adds a basic shape, inline or anchored, to the current paragraph.
commands.notes: -Left/-Top become -X/-Y; omitting them keeps the shape inline.

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordTextBox
commands.synopsis: Adds a positioned text box.
commands.notes: Centimeter-suffixed geometry becomes lengths; -WrapText becomes -Wrap as on images.

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordWatermark
commands.synopsis: Adds a text or image watermark to the current section.
commands.notes: -HorizontalOffset/-VerticalOffset become -X/-Y lengths.

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordHeader
commands.synopsis: Adds content to the section header (default, first-page or even-page).
commands.notes: Declares [OutputType].

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordFooter
commands.synopsis: Adds content to the section footer (default, first-page or even-page).
commands.notes: Declares [OutputType].

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordPageNumber
commands.synopsis: Adds the current page number, optionally 'of' the total, inline in a header or footer.
commands.notes: -IncludeTotalPages becomes -IncludeTotal. Inside a paragraph it appends PAGE (and ' of ' NUMPAGES) fields to that paragraph, so WordFooter { WordText 'Page '; WordPageNumber -IncludeTotal } stays on one line; directly in WordHeader/WordFooter it adds one paragraph aligned per the theme. -Format and -Separator exist in the source but were not exposed as parameters; they become real parameters.

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordTableOfContents
commands.synopsis: Adds a table of contents built from heading styles.

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordCoverPage
commands.synopsis: Adds a built-in cover page template.
commands.notes: -PublishDate becomes a DateTime formatted with -Culture rules of the document.

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordContentControl
commands.synopsis: Adds a plain or rich text content control.

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordCheckBox
commands.synopsis: Adds a check box content control.

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordComboBox
commands.synopsis: Adds a combo box content control.

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordDatePicker
commands.synopsis: Adds a date picker content control.

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordDropDownList
commands.synopsis: Adds a drop-down list content control.

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordPictureControl
commands.synopsis: Adds a picture content control.

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordRepeatingSection
commands.synopsis: Adds a repeating section content control.

commands.name: Set-OfficeWordPageSetup
commands.synopsis: Sets page size, orientation, margins and columns on sections.
commands.notes: -Index is 1-based. Twip integers become lengths. The WordMargin preset moves to -MarginPreset so -Margin is the shared all-sides length; side margins get the Margin prefix and header/footer distances a Distance suffix to read unambiguously.

commands.name: Set-OfficeWordBackground
commands.synopsis: Sets the document page background to a color or image.
commands.notes: Gains the WordBackground alias because it is used inside New-OfficeWord blocks (as PdfBackground/PptBackground are). Pixel sizes become lengths.

commands.name: Set-OfficeWordDocumentProperty
commands.synopsis: Sets a built-in or custom document property.

commands.name: Set-OfficeWordParagraph
commands.synopsis: Changes style, alignment, spacing, indentation and pagination of an existing or the current paragraph.
commands.notes: Was Set-OfficeWordParagraphStyle. bool? parameters become switches; -KeepWithNext:$false turns a setting off. Without -Paragraph it formats the current DSL paragraph, so it works inside WordParagraph blocks without an alias.

commands.name: Set-OfficeWordText
commands.synopsis: Changes text and character formatting of an existing or the current paragraph's runs.
commands.notes: Was Set-OfficeWordTextStyle. Pairs with Get-OfficeWordText output. bool? become switches (-Bold:$false removes bold). Uses the shared run names (-Font, -Size, -Strikethrough).

commands.name: Set-OfficeWordImage
commands.synopsis: Changes size, wrapping, crop, rotation, opacity and metadata of an image.
commands.notes: bool? become switches. Crop values stay in the current units of WordImage (not geometry lengths).

commands.name: Set-OfficeWordShape
commands.synopsis: Changes size, position, colors and metadata of a shape.

commands.name: Set-OfficeWordTableCell
commands.synopsis: Changes text, padding, fill, width, merging and splitting of table cells.
commands.notes: Centimeter padding becomes lengths; -ShadingFillColor becomes -BackgroundColor as in WordTableCondition. -Width plus -WidthType becomes -Width (length) or -WidthPercent; a null margin still clears the explicit padding. Word wraps by default, so the bool? -WrapText becomes -NoWrap.

commands.name: Set-OfficeWordTableOfContents
commands.synopsis: Changes the heading and empty-state text of a table of contents.

commands.name: Get-OfficeWordParagraph
commands.synopsis: Gets paragraphs from a document or section, optionally only those matching a pattern.
commands.notes: Absorbs Find-OfficeWord: -Pattern is a regular expression unless -SimpleMatch (Select-String vocabulary, as Search-OfficeDocument). -AsResult returns WordSearchResult match details instead of paragraphs. For searching many files use Search-OfficeDocument.

commands.name: Get-OfficeWordText
commands.synopsis: Gets the text runs of paragraphs, sections or documents.
commands.notes: The Paragraph set stays the pipeline default for Get-OfficeWordParagraph | Get-OfficeWordText.

commands.name: Get-OfficeWordSection
commands.synopsis: Gets sections of a document.
commands.notes: -Index is 1-based (it was zero-based).

commands.name: Get-OfficeWordList
commands.synopsis: Gets lists, optionally only those with an item matching a pattern.
commands.notes: Absorbs Find-OfficeWordList.

commands.name: Get-OfficeWordTable
commands.synopsis: Gets tables, optionally only those with a cell matching a pattern.
commands.notes: Absorbs Find-OfficeWordTable.

commands.name: Get-OfficeWordTableCell
commands.synopsis: Gets cells of a table, all or by row and column.
commands.notes: -Row and -Column are 1-based.

commands.name: Get-OfficeWordImage
commands.synopsis: Gets images from a document, section or paragraph.

commands.name: Get-OfficeWordShape
commands.synopsis: Gets shapes from a document, section or paragraph.

commands.name: Get-OfficeWordHyperlink
commands.synopsis: Gets hyperlinks, filtered by text, URL or bookmark anchor.
commands.notes: The Uri/Bookmark parameter aliases are removed.

commands.name: Get-OfficeWordBookmark
commands.synopsis: Gets bookmarks, optionally by name (wildcards).

commands.name: Get-OfficeWordField
commands.synopsis: Gets fields, filtered by type or field code text.

commands.name: Get-OfficeWordFootnote
commands.synopsis: Gets footnotes of a document or section.

commands.name: Get-OfficeWordEndnote
commands.synopsis: Gets endnotes of a document or section.

commands.name: Get-OfficeWordContentControl
commands.synopsis: Gets content controls of any kind, filtered by kind, alias, tag, text or check state.
commands.outputType: WordStructuredDocumentTag, WordCheckBox, WordComboBox, WordDatePicker, WordDropDownList, WordPictureControl, WordRepeatingSection
commands.notes: Absorbs the six per-kind Get- commands. -Type takes Text, CheckBox, ComboBox, DatePicker, DropDownList, Picture, RepeatingSection (default: all). -State Checked|Unchecked replaces the -Checked/-Unchecked pair and implies -Type CheckBox. Each kind keeps its own output type.

commands.name: Get-OfficeWordDocumentProperty
commands.synopsis: Gets built-in and custom document properties.
commands.notes: Generic metadata also appears in Get-OfficeDocumentInfo; this command stays for custom properties and the Set- pair.

commands.name: Get-OfficeWordTableOfContents
commands.synopsis: Gets the table of contents of a document.

commands.name: Get-OfficeWordReview
commands.synopsis: Reports comments, threads, tracked revisions and unsupported review metadata.

commands.name: Update-OfficeWordText
commands.synopsis: Replaces text (and optionally hyperlink parts) in a document and returns the count.
commands.notes: The Replace-OfficeWordText alias is removed (unapproved verb). The Auto set is named Context. Path sets save the file in place; ShouldProcess applies to them only.

commands.name: Update-OfficeWordField
commands.synopsis: Updates field results (page numbers, dates, TOC fields) in a document.
commands.notes: Singular noun (was Update-OfficeWordFields).

commands.name: Update-OfficeWordTableOfContents
commands.synopsis: Refreshes or regenerates the table of contents.

commands.name: Remove-OfficeWordTableOfContents
commands.synopsis: Removes the table of contents from a document.
commands.notes: Changes document content, not files, so it has no -WhatIf.

commands.name: Invoke-OfficeWordMailMerge
commands.synopsis: Fills MERGEFIELD fields from a hashtable or object.
commands.notes: Word-specific job; kept. The Data/Values parameter aliases are removed.

commands.name: Resolve-OfficeWordRevision
commands.synopsis: Accepts or rejects tracked revisions matching a filter and returns an operation report.
commands.notes: Word-specific review job; kept. -OutputPath never replaces the input implicitly.

commands.name: New-OfficeWordRevisionFilter
commands.synopsis: Creates a revision filter (author, id, type, dates, location) for Resolve-OfficeWordRevision.
commands.notes: A filter, not an options object, so it keeps its name. The In/NotIn pairs stay switches; giving both of a pair is an argument error.

commands.name: Export-OfficeWordGoogleDocument
commands.synopsis: Plans, compiles or uploads a Word document as a Google Docs document.
commands.notes: Not a file-to-file conversion (it targets a Google Workspace service), so it stays a Word command like Export-OfficeExcelGoogleSpreadsheet.

commands.name: New-OfficeWordPdfOptions
commands.synopsis: Creates Word-to-PDF settings for Convert-OfficeDocument -To Pdf.
commands.notes: Margins in PDF points become lengths. Moves with the Word-to-PDF adapter (OfficeIMO.Word.Pdf).

commands.name: New-OfficeWordImageOptions
commands.synopsis: Creates page-range and rendering settings for Export-OfficeDocumentImage on Word files.
commands.notes: Inner numeric types follow WordImageExportOptions. Resource limits are API-enforced and stay; pixel limits are counts (...PixelCount). -PageIndex is 1-based.

commands.name: New-OfficeWordComparisonOptions
commands.synopsis: Creates structural comparison settings for Compare-OfficeDocument on Word files.
commands.notes: Every Compare* option defaults to on in WordComparisonOptions, so each becomes a -No{Feature} switch (-CompareVolatileMetadata:$false becomes -NoVolatileMetadata).

commands.name: New-OfficeWordOpenDocumentOptions
commands.synopsis: Creates Word-to-OpenDocument (.odt) settings for Convert-OfficeDocument -To OpenDocument.
commands.notes: LossPolicy should collapse into the shared -FailOnLoss once OdfConversionLossPolicy migrates to OfficeConversionReport (C# map).

commands.name: New-OfficeWordHtmlOptions
commands.synopsis: Creates Word-to-HTML settings for Convert-OfficeDocument -To Html.
commands.notes: Carries the format-specific parameters of ConvertTo-OfficeWordHtml.

commands.name: New-OfficeWordMarkdownOptions
commands.synopsis: Creates Word-to-Markdown settings for Convert-OfficeDocument -To Markdown.
commands.notes: Carries the format-specific parameters of ConvertTo-OfficeWordMarkdown.

commands.name: New-OfficeHtmlWordOptions
commands.synopsis: Creates HTML-to-Word settings for Convert-OfficeDocument -To Word.
commands.notes: Source-target naming as New-OfficeHtmlPdfOptions and New-OfficePdfToWordOptions. Listed in the Word map because it replaces ConvertFrom-OfficeWordHtml; the markup map should reference, not duplicate, it.

commands.name: New-OfficeMarkdownWordOptions
commands.synopsis: Creates Markdown-to-Word settings (template insertion, images, profile) for Convert-OfficeDocument -To Word.
commands.notes: Carries every format-specific parameter of ConvertFrom-OfficeWordMarkdown, including inserting the Markdown into a template at a bookmark or content control. bool? NormalizeInput (default on) becomes -NoNormalizeInput; AllowDataUriImages bool? becomes a switch. Pixel image limits become lengths. -Theme takes the shared OfficeTheme instead of the Markdown-specific theme enum. Inner enum names follow the C# options.
